title: Minimal execution kernel validation
problem: The orchestration stack can appear active while planner, reviewer, policy, or daemon layers prevent proof of real execution.
guarantees: Runs locally with deterministic synthetic data fallback.
Produces a markdown artifact and machine-readable metrics.
Does not require external datasets or planner routing.
residual_risk: The smoke run proves a closed local execution loop, but it does not prove that the general multi-agent task pipeline can complete arbitrary shell or coding work.
